description: This Go source file contains unit tests for generating Go wrapper functions for TensorFlow operations based on their protocol buffer definitions. It defines various test cases with op definitions and expected generated code, verifying that the code generator produces the correct functions and associated optional argument structures.

methods.name: GetAPIDef

methods.name: TestGenerateOp
methods.description: Unit test validating the generated source code functions for various operation definitions.
